title: Tool result
description: The envelope every MCP tool returns. Tagged union on the boolean "ok". Failures are returned with isError set on the MCP response, never thrown, so the model can recover.

oneOf.title: Success

id.description: The move id that was played.

applied.description: Echo of what make_move actually played, so the model confirms rather than infers.

state.description: A fresh state view taken after the move, so a successful make_move needs no follow-up get_state.

note.description: Free-text guidance, e.g. that the host must still start the game after joining.

oneOf.description: Both applied and state are optional: join_match and leave_match succeed without either.

error.description: Readable cause. The model reads this as text and is expected to act on it.

legal-ids.description: Present when a move id matched nothing in a fresh enumeration: the ids that ARE valid now, so recovery costs no extra round trip.

rejected.description: The move dispatched but the authoritative state id did not advance in the wait window. Deliberately ambiguous between an engine rejection and a still-pending update, and the message says so.

attempted.description: What was dispatched, on a rejected move.

state.description: Current state where one exists, so the model can re-orient in the same call it failed on.

current-player.description: Present on a not-your-turn failure, so the model knows who to wait for.
